title: CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen's Girl
chineseTitle: 第 34 章：奎恩学院的女学生

paragraphs.en: Anne was busy preparing for her upcoming move to Queen's College during the next three weeks. There was much sewing and planning to be done. Matthew ensured she had an ample and pretty outfit, with Marilla’s approval.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮正忙于为接下来三周即将前往女王学院做准备。她需要缝制和规划很多东西。马修确保她有一套既体面又合适的行装，得到了玛丽拉的认可。

paragraphs.en: One evening, Anne received a delicate pale green material from Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: 一个傍晚，玛丽拉送给安妮一种淡绿色的精细布料。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, this is for a light dress," Marilla said. "I think you should have something fancy for evenings out in town—parties or social events. Jane, Ruby, and Josie all have 'evening dresses,' and I don't want you to be left behind."
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，这是做晚礼服的布料，”玛丽拉说，“我觉得你应该有一件 fancy 的衣服用来参加镇上的晚会或社交活动。简、ruby 和乔西都有‘晚礼服’，我不想让你落在后面。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla had chosen the fabric with Mrs. Allan's help and planned to get Emily Gillis to sew it. "Emily has good taste," Marilla said, "and her work is unmatched."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉在艾伦太太的帮助下选好了布料，并打算请伊米莉·吉里斯来缝制。“伊米莉品味不错，”玛丽拉说，“她的手艺也是首屈一指的。”

paragraphs.en: Anne was thrilled by the gift.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮对这份礼物感到非常激动。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Marilla, it’s lovely," Anne exclaimed. "Thank you so much. I feel even more reluctant to leave now."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，玛丽拉，真是太美好了，”安妮脱口而出，“非常感谢你。我现在更是不愿意离开了。”

paragraphs.en: The dress, adorned with tucks and frills, was completed according to Emily's design. Anne wore it for Matthew and Marilla, reciting "The Maiden's Vow" in the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 这件装饰着褶皱和花边的裙子是按照艾米丽的设计完成的。安妮在厨房里对着马修和玛丽拉背诵了《少女之誓》。

paragraphs.en: Marilla remembered Anne’s arrival at Green Gables, seeing her as a frightened child in an odd yellowish-brown dress. The memory brought tears to Marilla’s eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉想起了安妮初次来到绿山墙的情景，当时她是个害怕的小女孩，穿着一件奇怪的淡黄色连衣裙。这个记忆让玛丽拉的眼眶湿润了。

paragraphs.en: Anne noticed Marilla’s emotions and playfully said, "I made you cry, Marilla. That's a definite success."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮注意到玛丽拉的情绪，开玩笑地说：“让你哭了，玛丽拉。这可是个十足的胜利。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla said, "No, I wasn't crying over your poem. I just thought of the little girl you used to be, Anne. I wished you could stay young, even with all your quirks.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉说：“不，我不是因为你的诗而哭的。我只是想起了你小时候的那个小女孩，安妮。我真希望你能永远年轻，哪怕带着你所有的怪癖。”

paragraphs.en: You've grown up and are leaving; you look so tall and stylish—so different in that dress—it's as if you don’t belong here anymore. It made me feel lonely."
paragraphs.zh: 你已经长大，要离开了；穿上那套衣服的你看起来如此高挑时尚——如此不同——仿佛不属于这里了。这让我感到有些孤独。

paragraphs.en: Anne sat on Marilla’s lap, took her face in her hands, and looked into Marilla’s eyes gravely. "I haven't changed much, really. I'm just pruned down and grown more mature.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮坐在玛丽拉的膝上，双手捧起玛丽拉的脸颊，认真地注视着她的双眼。“其实我没有太大变化。我只是被修剪得更少了，成熟了许多。”

paragraphs.en: The real me—inside—is still the same. Wherever I go or whatever changes happen to me, my heart will always belong to you and Matthew, and Green Gables."
paragraphs.zh: 真正的我——内心深处——始终如一。无论我去往何方，或是经历怎样的变化，我的心永远属于你们和绿山墙。

paragraphs.en: She kissed Marilla’s cheek and patted Matthew's shoulder. Marilla wished she could express her feelings as Anne did but hugged her tightly instead.
paragraphs.zh: 她亲了亲玛丽拉的脸颊，拍了拍马修的肩膀。玛丽拉 wish 她能像安妮一样表达自己的感受，但还是紧紧地抱住了她。

paragraphs.en: Matthew, with tears in his eyes, went outside. Under the summer night sky, he walked agitatedly across the yard to the gate under the poplars.
paragraphs.zh: 马修眼中含泪，走出门外。在夏夜的星空下，他急切地在庭院中踱步，穿过白杨树下的大门。

paragraphs.en: "Well now," he muttered proudly, "she hasn't been much spoiled. My occasional advice probably didn’t do any harm. She’s smart and pretty, and loving—better than anything else.
paragraphs.zh: “她可没怎么被惯坏，”他自豪地咕哝道，“偶尔给点建议应该也没害处。她聪明又漂亮，还很善良——比其他任何东西都好。

paragraphs.en: She's been a blessing to us. If Mrs. Spencer made that mistake, it was lucky for us. I don’t think it was luck; Providence saw we needed her."
paragraphs.zh: 她对我们来说是一份恩赐。如果斯宾塞太太犯了那个错误，对我们来说倒成了好事。我认为这并非巧合；是天意让我们需要她的。

paragraphs.en: Anne and Matthew drove into town one crisp September morning, leaving Diana behind with Marilla at Green Gables. Diana quickly recovered from her tears, enjoying a picnic at White Sands with her cousins. Marilla, however, threw herself into work, feeling deep sorrow that Anne was gone.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和马修在一个秋风送爽的早晨驾车进城，把戴安娜留在绿山墙农舍由玛丽拉照看。戴安娜很快从悲伤中走了出来，在白沙滩上与堂姐们享受了一顿野餐。然而，玛丽拉则一头扎进了工作中，心中满是安妮离去的深深失落。

paragraphs.en: That day, Anne and the Avonlea scholars arrived just in time for the Academy. The first day was filled with excitement as they met new students and professors, and were sorted into classes. Anne planned to take up Second Year work, advised by Miss Stacy, while Gilbert Blythe chose the same path.
paragraphs.zh: 那天，安妮和埃文利的同学们恰好赶到学院，正好赶上开学典礼。第一天充满了兴奋，她们遇到了新同学和教授，并被分到了不同的班级。安妮打算在斯泰西小姐的建议下修读二年级课程，而吉尔伯特·布赖斯则选择了同样的道路。

paragraphs.en: This meant a more rigorous schedule but also a chance at a First Class teacher's license in one year.
paragraphs.zh: 这意味着更加严格的日程安排，但也有一年内获得一等教师资格证的机会。

paragraphs.en: Anne felt a pang of loneliness among fifty unfamiliar faces, except for the tall, brown-haired boy across the room. Despite this, she was glad to be in the same class as him; their old rivalry could continue. Anne wondered what she would do without it.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在五十张陌生面孔中感到一丝孤独，只有一名高大的棕色头发男孩隔室而坐。尽管如此，她还是高兴能和他同班；她们之间旧日的竞争可以继续下去。安妮不禁思考如果没有这种竞争，自己会如何应对。

paragraphs.en: Anne felt uneasy without something familiar. Gilbert seemed resolute, determined to win the medal. She noticed his strong chin for the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮感到缺少了些熟悉感。吉尔伯特显得决心坚定，似乎志在必得那枚奖章。她第一次注意到他下巴的线条十分坚毅。

paragraphs.en: She wished Jane and Ruby had joined First Class as well. Anne hoped getting to know her classmates would ease her loneliness.
paragraphs.zh: 她巴望简和ruby也能加入一等舱。安妮希望能多认识一些同学，这样或许能减轻她的孤独感。

paragraphs.en: She wondered which girls might become friends. Diana’s promise weighed on her mind—no matter how much she liked a Queen's girl, none could be as dear as Diana. But she had other affections to share.
paragraphs.zh: 她想着可能会成为朋友的那些女孩。戴安娜的承诺让她难以忘怀——不管自己多么喜欢一位王室小姐，也比不上戴安娜亲近。但她还有其他感情要分享。

paragraphs.en: She admired the girl with brown eyes and a crimson waist; she seemed vibrant and rosy-cheeked. The pale, fair one by the window caught her eye too, with lovely hair and an air of knowing dreams.
paragraphs.zh: 她欣赏那位棕色眼睛、红润腰身的女孩，看起来充满活力，脸颊绯红。窗边的那个淡色头发、眼神中透着梦幻气质的姑娘也引起了她的注意。

paragraphs.en: Anne longed to know them well enough to walk arm-in-arm and use nicknames. But for now, they were strangers, just like her. She felt lonely, even lonelier when she was alone in her hall bedroom at twilight.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮渴望与她们亲密到可以并肩而行、互叫昵称。但眼下，她们还是陌生人，和她一样。她在黄昏时分独自躺在大厅卧室里，感到更加孤独。

paragraphs.en: Unlike the other girls who had relatives nearby, Anne would board with a boarding-house keeper, Miss Barry.
paragraphs.zh: 不同于其他有近亲的女孩，安妮将寄宿在巴里小姐这样的膳宿家庭。

paragraphs.en: Miss Barry explained that the lady of the house was a reduced gentlewoman whose husband was a British officer. She took careful boarders and ensured Anne wouldn’t meet anyone objectionable. The table was good, and the house was near the academy in a quiet neighborhood.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里小姐解释说，这家的女主人是一位境况不如从前的贵族妇人，她的丈夫是一名英国军官。这位女士挑选住客十分谨慎，确保安妮不会遇到任何让她感到不适的人。饭菜质量不错，房子位于安静的学区附近，离学院也不远。

paragraphs.en: Anne felt utterly homesick in her small, bare room at the orphanage. The dull walls, empty bookcase, and iron bedstead reminded her painfully of Green Gables, where she enjoyed sweet peas, moonlight, and a vast starry sky. Outside her window, she saw only a hard street with telephone wires and stranger faces.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在孤儿院那间狭小、空荡的房间里感到无比思乡。灰暗的墙壁、空空如也的书架和冰冷的铁床让她痛苦地想起了绿山墙农庄，那里有她喜爱的甜豌豆、月光下的漫步以及无尽的星光。透过窗户，她只能看到一条冷冰冰的街道，上面布满了电话线和陌生人的面孔。

paragraphs.en: She knew she was about to cry but fought against it.
paragraphs.zh: 她知道自己快要哭出来了，但还是努力抑制住了。

paragraphs.en: "I won't cry," Anne told herself. "It's silly and weak." But tears began to fall, four, five, six—soon they would come in a flood.
paragraphs.zh: “我不会哭的，”安妮心里对自己说，“这太傻了，也太脆弱了。”但她的眼泪还是不由自主地流了下来，先是四滴、五滴、六滴——很快，泪水就会像洪流般涌出。

paragraphs.en: She didn’t want to cheer up; it was nicer to be miserable.
paragraphs.zh: 她不想高兴起来；沮丧反而让她觉得更舒服一些。

paragraphs.en: Just then, Josie Pye entered the room. Seeing a familiar face, Anne forgot her initial resentment.
paragraphs.zh: 就在这时，乔西·皮伊走进了房间。见到一张熟悉的脸庞，安妮顿时忘掉了最初的不满。

paragraphs.en: "I'm so glad you came," Anne said sincerely.
paragraphs.zh: “你来了真是太好了，”安妮由衷地说。

paragraphs.en: Anne noticed Jane and Ruby, each wearing a proud purple and scarlet ribbon from Queen's Academy, as Josie was not speaking to Jane at the moment. Anne felt relieved to retreat into comparative silence.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮注意到简和鲁比各自佩戴着来自女王学院的骄傲的紫色和红色丝带，此时乔西并没有跟简说话。安妮感到如释重负，可以暂时退回到相对安静的状态中。

paragraphs.en: Jane sighed, saying she felt like she had lived many moons since morning. She should have been studying Virgil but couldn't concentrate tonight. She saw traces of tears on Anne and admitted to crying.
paragraphs.zh: 简叹了口气，说感觉自己仿佛已经度过了好几个夜晚。她本应专心研读维吉尔的作品，但今晚却无法集中精神。她注意到安妮脸上还有泪痕，并坦白自己刚刚哭过。

paragraphs.en: Ruby asked for a piece of cake, which Anne gladly gave her, noting the Avonlea flavor.
paragraphs.zh: 鲁比要了一块蛋糕，安妮欣然给了她，并注意到了埃文利特有的风味。

paragraphs.en: Ruby noticed the Queen's calendar and inquired if Anne planned to try for the gold medal. Anne blushed and confessed she was considering it. Josie then mentioned that Queen's would receive an Avery scholarship after all.
paragraphs.zh: 鲁比注意到女王学院的日历，便询问安妮是否打算争取那枚金牌。安妮脸红了，承认自己正在考虑这个问题。乔西随后提到，女王学院最终还是会获得艾维瑞奖学金的。

paragraphs.en: Frank Stockley had informed her; his uncle was on the board of governors, and the news would be announced at the Academy tomorrow.
paragraphs.zh: 弗兰克·斯托克利告诉她这个消息；他的叔叔是校董会成员，明天学院将会正式宣布这一消息。

paragraphs.en: Anne felt her heart race upon hearing about the Avery scholarship. Her dreams suddenly expanded, envisioning herself earning a First Class provincial license and then winning this prestigious award. She imagined herself attending Redmond College in a gown and mortarboard, all within moments of Josie's announcement.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮听到阿维里奖学金的消息后，心跳不由得加速。她的梦想顿时变得宏大起来，想象自己能够获得一等省级证书，进而赢得这项崇高的荣誉。她幻想着自己身着学位长袍和方帽，前往雷德蒙德学院求学，这一切都在乔西宣布消息的瞬间闪现于脑海中。

paragraphs.en: The scholarship was awarded to the top student in English and English Literature at Queen's high school. A wealthy New Brunswick manufacturer had left part of his fortune to fund these scholarships for Maritime Province schools. Anne resolved that she would work hard to win it, imagining Matthew’s pride if she became a B.A.
paragraphs.zh: 奖学金授予女王高中英语及文学成绩最优的学生。一位富裕的新不伦瑞克制造商留有一部分财产，用于资助马里兰地区的学校设立此类奖学金。安妮下定决心要努力争取这个奖项，想象着如果自己能成为学士，马修会为此感到多么自豪。

paragraphs.en: She reveled in having so many ambitions, noting how they kept growing and making life endlessly interesting.
paragraphs.zh: 她对自己的众多抱负感到欣喜，发现它们不断增长，让生活充满了无尽的趣味。
